title: Convergence of Bergman measures towards the Zhang measure
abstract: We prove a folklore conjecture that the Bergman measure along a holomorphic family of curves parametrized by the punctured unit disk converges to the Zhang measure on the associated Berkovich space. The convergence takes place on a Berkovich hybrid space. We also study the convergence of the Bergman measure to a measure on a metrized curve complex in the sense of Amini and Baker.
